title: X-direction motion type
description: Essential: Correctly identifies motion in x-direction as uniform linear motion from displacement-time graph.

title: Y-direction motion type
description: Essential: Correctly identifies motion in y-direction as uniformly accelerated linear motion from velocity-time graph.

title: Velocity magnitude calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes velocity magnitude using Pythagorean theorem with x and y components at t=2s.

title: Displacement magnitude calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes displacement magnitude using Pythagorean theorem with x and y displacements at t=2s.

title: Velocity components extraction
description: Important: Correctly reads v_x from x-displacement graph slope and v_y from y-velocity graph at t=2s.

title: Displacement components extraction
description: Important: Correctly reads x-displacement from graph and calculates y-displacement from velocity-time graph area at t=2s.

title: Graph interpretation reasoning
description: Optional: Explains how graph shapes indicate uniform vs. accelerated motion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Includes proper units (m/s, m) in final answers.

title: Confusing displacement with velocity
description: Pitfall: Misinterpreting x-displacement graph as velocity graph or vice versa.

title: Vector addition error
description: Pitfall: Adding velocity/displacement components linearly instead of using Pythagorean theorem.
